description: Search the live token/NFT census for Robinhood Chain (4663) and HyperEVM (999) by symbol or name. Returns matching tokens with address, standard (erc20/erc721/erc1155), decimals, holders, market cap, and — for HyperEVM canonical tokens — live spot price + 24h volume. The census is refreshed hourly (canonical tokens from Hyperliquid spotMeta, top tokens from Blockscout, spam-filtered). Use this instead of discover_programs when you want a specific asset (e.g. "USDC on hyperevm", "stablecoins on robinhood") rather than the whole list.

chain.description: robinhood | hyperevm. Omit to search both.

query.description: Symbol or name substring, case-insensitive (e.g. "usdc", "hype"). Omit to list the top of the census.

name: search_tokens

censusAgeMin.description: minutes since the census cron last ran

items.description: address, symbol, name, standard, decimals, holders, marketCap, price
